title: Single-cell RNA-seq protocol for human lung tissue analysis
author: Quintanal-Villalonga, Chan, et al.

steps.title: Obtain approvals and ensure safety
steps.instruction: Secure institutional permits and patient consent for all human samples; wear lab coat, gloves, safety glasses; use sterile aerosol‑barrier pipette tips free of DNases/RNases; decontaminate work surfaces and dispose of biohazardous waste according to safety guidelines.

steps.title: Transport tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Limit ischemic time to < 1 hour from resection to dissociation; immediately place the specimen in phosphate‑buffered saline (pH 7.4) or cell‑culture medium (e.g., RPMI‑1640 or DMEM) and keep on ice during transport to the laboratory.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells for staining
steps.instruction: Spin cells in a FACS tube at 800 × g for 3 min at 20 °C–25 °C; carefully aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the pellet, leaving 50 µL of supernatant above the pellet.

steps.title: Prepare cell‑staining mix
steps.instruction: While the centrifugation is running, assemble the appropriate Cell Staining Mix (either for live‑cells or for CD45‑negative cells) as described in the Materials and Equipment section.

steps.title: Add staining mix to cells
steps.instruction: Combine the 50 µL cell suspension remaining from the previous step with 100 µL Cell Staining Mix for approximately 1 × 10⁶ cells; gently rock the tube or pipette up‑and‑down 2–3 times to disperse the cells.

steps.title: Incubate staining reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 15 min.

steps.title: Dilute and wash cells
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL refrigerated Cell Resuspension Buffer to the stained cells, then centrifuge in a swinging‑bucket centrifuge at 800 × g for 3 min.

steps.title: Resuspend in RPMI‑FBS
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant carefully, add 2 mL RPMI‑FBS (RPMI‑1640 medium supplemented with 2.5 % (v/v) fetal bovine serum), and centrifuge again at 800 × g for 3 min.

steps.title: Proceed to FACS enrichment
steps.instruction: Without delay, move the cell suspension to the next section (Part E: FACS live‑cell enrichment).
